source_semantic_review: All 34 current English sentences covered after composing PR169 plus the five exact next corrections. No remaining concrete semantic gap identified in this full-value pass. Independent full-coverage crosscheck pending; each new correction already has focused independent support.
qualification: Medium idiom, including documented productive modern vocabulary; not universal/traditional term standardization. No rendered, runtime, layout or device acceptance. No blanket whole-key HOLD based solely on those nonblocking confidence limits.

rows.english: Add up to 20 images with Android\'s file picker.
rows.candidate_span: Android ani cinuyep numke wa noka 20 pakno omare yan.
rows.semantic_reason: Android file-choice operation, 20-image limit and add instruction all explicit.

rows.english: The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider.
rows.candidate_span: Corpok ta pon noka, cinuyep rehe newa noka kor pororu a=nukare. Noka a=tuye hene 「Upakno a=kar seri」 hene 「Upakno a=kar kewerihi」 hene ani pororu a=sinnare hene ki yakun, a=nukare pororu ka ne neno a=sinnare. Cinuyep kore aeywankep cinuyep a=sinnare hi ka kore yakun, nea hi ka a=nukare.
rows.semantic_reason: One displayed dimension updates after crop/normalization. Provider availability qualifies modification time only.

rows.english: Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.
rows.candidate_span: Cinuyep rehe hene a=sinnare hi hene ani upekare easkay. Upekare yakka, a=anu noka kor uske a=sinnare ka somo ki.
rows.semantic_reason: Filename/time sorting distinct from positions of placed images.

rows.english: Tap a thumbnail to select it.
rows.candidate_span: Pon noka kik wa numke yan.
rows.semantic_reason: Thumbnail selection by tap.

rows.english: Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images.
rows.candidate_span: 「Noka tuye」 ani nea noka tuye easkay. 「Poronno noka tuye」 ani a=numke noka kor pes tuye kusu pixel hene % hene cipiskip anu yan.
rows.semantic_reason: Crop selected image and batch selected images using pixel/percentage edge amounts; exact captions.

rows.english: Drag crop handles or type amounts.
rows.candidate_span: Noka kor pes or ta an itokpa moymoye hene cipiskip nuye hene ki yan.
rows.semantic_reason: Drag edge markers or enter numbers.

rows.english: Reset crop restores the original edges.
rows.candidate_span: 「Noka pes hosipire」 ani hoski pes a=hosipire.
rows.semantic_reason: Reset crop restores initial edges.

rows.english: Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.
rows.candidate_span: A=omare cinuyep a=sinnare ka somo ki. 「Husko katukar」 ani tuye etoko an katu hosipire easkay.
rows.semantic_reason: Non-destructive expressed as input file unchanged; Undo restores pre-crop condition.

rows.english: Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge.
rows.candidate_span: Pon noka kisma wa moymoye yan. Uske or ta a=anu noka ka moymoye easkay. A=nukare pes or un noka anu yan.
rows.semantic_reason: Hold/drag thumbnail or move placed image, then place at displayed edge target. Displayed edge is the visible highlighted drop target in consumer, not an arbitrary image edge.

rows.english: The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result.
rows.candidate_span: Naa e=anu ka somo ki kor, e=anu kusu an noka a=nukare. Noka e=anu okere yakun, nea a=nukare noka kor uske ta an; pororu ka nea a=nukare noka kor pororu pakno an. Nea noka pok anpe ka a=nukar easkay.
rows.semantic_reason: Preview before placing is see-through and matches committed position/size after completion. No invariant-while-dragging claim.

rows.english: A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges.
rows.candidate_span: Simoysam un e=kote yakun sapa uneno an. Corpok un e=kote yakun harkisam pes uneno an.
rows.semantic_reason: Right attachment aligns tops; lower attachment aligns left edges. Spatial sameness is appropriate uneno context.

rows.english: You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target.
rows.candidate_span: Pon noka kik wa + kik ka easkay.
rows.semantic_reason: Alternate thumbnail then + target interaction.

rows.english: When snapping, the first image starts at the origin.
rows.candidate_span: Tan katu ani noka a=anu hi ta, hoski noka anak x=0, y=0 ta a=anu.
rows.semantic_reason: Anaphoric mode restriction scopes origin to preceding snap method.

rows.english: Attached images may move when their parent is cropped.
rows.candidate_span: Noka a=tuye yakun, nea noka or un a=kote noka a=moymoye hi ka an.
rows.semantic_reason: Explicit cropped parent antecedent; contingent movement, not permission or guaranteed motion.

rows.english: Overlaps are rejected when snapping.
rows.candidate_span: Tan katu ani noka a=anu hi ta, noka a=ukaomare eaykap.
rows.semantic_reason: Snap-specific overlap impossibility, including partial overlap; distinct from coordinate mode.

rows.english: Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero.
rows.candidate_span: Noka numke wa 「A=nuye cipiskip koracipo a=anu uske」 eywanke yan. A=sanke noka a=nuye uske or ta, tan noka tuyka ta ka tan noka harkisama ta ka an sikkew anu yan. X ka Y ka, 「0, 1, 2, 3, …」 or wa a=numke cipiskip ne; pixel ani, 0 wano a=piski.
rows.semantic_reason: Exact operation title, selected image, output-space top-left, X/Y, nonnegative whole pixel units explicit; accepted PR67 construction.

rows.english: Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.
rows.candidate_span: Mosma noka a=ari uske anak a=sinnare ka somo ki. Te ta noka a=ukaomare yakka pirka.
rows.semantic_reason: Other placements invariant and overlap permitted specifically in immediately named numeric mode.

rows.english: Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image\'s own aspect ratio.
rows.candidate_span: 「Upakno a=kar seri」 hene 「Upakno a=kar kewerihi」 hene ani noka opitta kor pararu hene riru hene upakno a=kar. Noka sinep sinep kor pararu newa riru anak uneno % ani a=sinnare.
rows.semantic_reason: Common axis equalized quantitatively; per-image width/height change by same percentage, preserving that image's ratio. No need for literal aspect-ratio noun.

rows.english: Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest.
rows.candidate_span: Pixel, %, 「Iyotta pon」 hene 「Iyotta poro」 hene numke yan.
rows.semantic_reason: All four choices preserved and captions match.

rows.english: Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.
rows.candidate_span: 「Hoski pororu hosipire」 ani pororu patek a=hosipire. A=tuye pes anak a=ama.
rows.semantic_reason: Restore only size/normalization, retain cropped edges.

rows.english: Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray.
rows.candidate_span: 「A=anu noka hosipire」 e=kik yakun a=numke noka patek corpok un a=hosipire.
rows.semantic_reason: Only selected input returns to bottom tray.

rows.english: Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap.
rows.candidate_span: Mosma noka anak a=ari wa oka. A=kote noka anak nea isam uske un a=moymoye hi ka an.
rows.semantic_reason: Other inputs remain placed; attached subset may move toward vacated space. Placement state is not identical-position invariance.

rows.english: Remove deletes only that input.
rows.candidate_span: 「Isamka」 ani nea noka patek a=isamka.
rows.semantic_reason: Only that input removed.

rows.english: Undo/Redo restore these changes.
rows.candidate_span: 「Husko katukar」 newa 「Suy ki」 ani tan sinna a=hosipire easkay.
rows.semantic_reason: Undo/Redo restore these changes.

rows.english: Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans.
rows.candidate_span: A=anu noka moymoye wa a=anu uske sinnare yan. Noka isam uske moymoye yakun, noka somo nuye no nukar uske a=moymoye.
rows.semantic_reason: Placed-image drag repositions; empty-space drag moves viewing area without drawing.

rows.english: Pinch to zoom.
rows.candidate_span: Tu askepet ani porore hene ponte hene ki yan.
rows.semantic_reason: Two-finger enlarge/shrink in adjacent view-navigation context, a usable pinch-to-zoom paraphrase; does not imply output resize.

rows.english: «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.
rows.candidate_span: 「Opitta nukare」 ani noka ukote opitta a=nukar pakno nukar pororu a=sinnare. A=sanke noka kor pororu a=sinnare ka somo ki.
rows.semantic_reason: Show-all adjusts viewing size to complete assembly, never output size.

rows.english: Save PNG saves the assembled image directly.
rows.candidate_span: 「PNG ama」 ani ukote noka PNG ne a=ama.
rows.semantic_reason: Named Save PNG action saves assembled PNG. Direct save is expressed operationally, contrasted with next editor-transfer action, not omitted functionality.

rows.english: Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement.
rows.candidate_span: 「Paint or ta nuye」 ani noka nuye kusu AN Paint un a=eikra. Nea noka ani tane an noka a=itasare; 「Husko katukar」 ani hosipire easkay.
rows.semantic_reason: Exact Edit-in-Paint caption anchors main drawing editor; replaces current image and can Undo. No separate application launch claim necessary.

rows.english: If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered.
rows.candidate_span: A=sanke noka a=kar hi ta, tane noka nuye kusu a=eywanke easkay RAM akkari na poronno RAM a=eywanke kuni a=ramu yakun, noka kor pororu a=numke uske a=nukare yakun, a=sanke kusu a=attupte noka na pon pe numke yan.
rows.semantic_reason: Expected output-operation memory versus currently usable image-editing budget. Choose smaller output copy only if chooser displayed.

rows.english: If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser.
rows.candidate_span: A=sanke noka ponpon yakka nea RAM akkari na poronno RAM a=eywanke kuni a=ramu yakun, AN Paint anak noka kor pororu a=numke uske nukare ka somo ki no, RAM ehaye sekor an itak nukare.
rows.semantic_reason: Even tiny output over budget causes insufficiency warning, explicitly without size chooser.

rows.english: Original source files stay unchanged.
rows.candidate_span: A=omare cinuyep a=sinnare ka somo ki.
rows.semantic_reason: Original input files unchanged.

rows.english: The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.
rows.candidate_span: Tane noka ukote anak kikay or ta a=ama. Suy e=maka yakun nea noka ukote a=hosipire.
rows.semantic_reason: Current assembly stored on device and restored on reopening/return.

rows.english: This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor\'s «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
rows.candidate_span: Tan aeywankep anak Catrobat/AGPL newa noka kar kur kor irenka ani a=eywanke. AN Paint kor 「Cinuyep → Yayopeyope, uesere newa kar kur」 or ta irenka newa kar kur kor rehe opitta nukar easkay.
rows.semantic_reason: Catrobat/AGPL and image-credit terms refer to the exact main-editor information/licence/credits route. Same attribution is operationally identified, not a new licence grant.
